name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install packaging tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev debhelper

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Create .deb package
        id: package
        run: |
          PACKAGE_FILE=mise_$(git describe --tags --always)_amd64.deb
